entities.summary: Switzerland was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 1990 with the song "Musik klingt in die welt hinaus", written by Cornelia Lackner, and performed by Egon Egemann. The Swiss participating broadcaster, the Swiss Broadcasting Corporation, selected its entry through a national final.
